name: NCBench
description: An open, reproducible, adaptable, and continuous benchmarking framework for DNA-sequencing-based variant calling that enables ongoing evaluation of pipelines.
typical_sota_score: SNPs: ~98–99% F1; indels: ~90–97% F1 (varies by dataset and pipeline)
reputation: An open, reproducible framework used by genomics and variant-calling researchers for continuous benchmarking; moderate adoption in the bioinformatics community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark requiring substantial compute and high-quality truth sets; results depend on sequencing platform, coverage, and reference truth variants; designed for continuous and reproducible evaluation.
